tasks.title: Where cmd_vel in the map frame will go
tasks.solution: In map (ENU) x is east and y is north; AP_DDS converts to NED as (north, east) = (y, x). Course = atan2(east, north) = atan2(x, y), wrapped to 0…360°. The module's example: x = 1, y = 2 → NED (2, 1) → 26.6°. A common mistake is atan2(y, x): that is the angle from east, counterclockwise (the mathematical angle), not the course.

tasks.title: How many times the GCS will print "exiting"
tasks.solution: A batch lasts DDS_TIMEOUT_MS × DDS_MAX_RETRY; after each failed batch there is one "exiting" message, and the loop continues. Before the agent starts, ⌊(t − 2) / (ms·r/1000)⌋ batches have time to finish. The module's example: 1000 ms × 10, agent at 35 s → ⌊33/10⌋ = 3 messages (at 12, 22, 32 s). On a batch boundary (t − 2 a multiple of the batch length) the agent comes up exactly at the end of a batch: a race, answer ±1.
